trigger.description: A bounded scale-envelope probe exhausts its configured time or row budget before observing every requested posture source. The envelope returns known fields plus an explicit degraded code rather than blocking indefinitely.
trigger.invocation: Run a scale envelope probe with a budget smaller than the source set requires, such as a large corpus with store, WAL, index, and command-SLO probes enabled.

expected_emission.repair_string: Increase the probe budget or reduce the requested posture sections, then rerun the scale envelope probe.
